macos-arm64.methodology: Whole-program wall time, 7 iterations median; Linux RSS from separate post-exec tracing, macOS wait4, Windows peak working set; verified stdout

benches.name: ackermann
benches.desc_zh: 阿克曼-彼得函数非尾深层递归（ack 3, 10）
benches.desc_en: Ackermann-Peter deep non-tail recursion (ack 3, 10)

benches.name: fib
benches.desc_zh: 深度递归计算与调用栈开销（fib 34/35）
benches.desc_en: Deep recursion & call stack baseline

benches.name: collatz
benches.desc_zh: 考拉兹 3n+1 猜想停止时间累加（10万区间整数递归）
benches.desc_en: Sum of Collatz stopping times over 1..100,000

benches.name: hanoi
benches.desc_zh: 经典汉诺塔双递归移动步数计数（n=25）
benches.desc_en: Towers of Hanoi exponential double recursion (n=25)

benches.name: pascal
benches.desc_zh: 二项式系数组合数无备忘展开递归（C 27, 13）
benches.desc_en: Binomial coefficient recursion C(27, 13)

benches.name: tak
benches.desc_zh: 竹内函数三元自递归与参数嵌套求值（tak 32, 16, 8）
benches.desc_en: Takeuchi function ternary self-recursion (tak 32, 16, 8)

benches.name: mutual_recursion
benches.desc_zh: 相互递归函数调用链奇偶性判定（13万次交替调用）
benches.desc_en: Mutually recursive parity chain (130,000 iterations)

benches.name: nested_loop
benches.desc_zh: 多层深层嵌套循环乘法与模乘累加
benches.desc_en: Nested loops integer multiplication & modular accumulation

benches.name: digitsum
benches.desc_zh: 200万连续整数各位十进制数字和累加
benches.desc_en: Sum of decimal digit-sums over 1..2,000,000

benches.name: factorial_mod
benches.desc_zh: 千万级连续阶乘模乘折叠（mod 1000000007）
benches.desc_en: Product 1..10,000,000 mod 1000000007 multiplication fold

benches.name: gcd_sum
benches.desc_zh: 欧几里得最大公约数递归累加求和（200万轮取模）
benches.desc_en: Euclidean GCD recursion and modulo accumulation over 2M steps

benches.name: isqrt
benches.desc_zh: 百万整数牛顿迭代法求平方根与除法密集计算
benches.desc_en: Newton's method integer square roots over 1..1,000,000

benches.name: powmod
benches.desc_zh: 百万整数高阶模幂连续累加（20次模乘折叠）

benches.name: coprime
benches.desc_zh: 2000×2000 网格互质数对统计（嵌套遍历与辗转相除）
benches.desc_en: Count coprime pairs in a 2000x2000 grid via Euclidean GCD

benches.name: sieve_primes
benches.desc_zh: 连续质数筛法与区间素数统计
benches.desc_en: Prime computation and sieve counting in hot loop

benches.name: coins
benches.desc_zh: SICP 硬币找零组合数穷举递归（总金额 600）
benches.desc_en: Combinatorial coin change ways for amount 600 (SICP)

benches.name: josephus
benches.desc_zh: 千万级约瑟夫环幸存者索引迭代求解（n=10000000, k=7）
benches.desc_en: Josephus survivor index computation (n=10M, k=7)

benches.name: binarytrees
benches.desc_zh: 深度拥有型二叉树连续构建与校验
benches.desc_en: Owning binary trees continuous build and check

benches.name: expr_tree
benches.desc_zh: 深度 14 表达式树拥有型结构构建与递归求值
benches.desc_en: Owning expression trees of depth 14 build and evaluate

benches.name: merge_sort
benches.desc_zh: 交替划分递归归并排序与动态向量重构
benches.desc_en: Alternating split recursive merge sort with dynamic vectors

benches.name: quicksort_hoare
benches.desc_zh: 经典双向分区递归快速排序
benches.desc_en: Bidirectional partition recursive quicksort

benches.name: listops
benches.desc_zh: 动态扩容向量组构建与递归区间遍历统计
benches.desc_en: Growable vectors recursive traversal and range predicate count

benches.name: textstats
benches.desc_zh: 20万词元文本流长度统计与前后缀模式扫描
benches.desc_en: 200,000 tokens length, substring and prefix pattern scanning

benches.name: word_frequency
benches.desc_zh: 20万词元字符串哈希频次映射与加权词频统计
benches.desc_en: 200,000 tokens string-keyed frequency map and weighted counts
